commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate source through its engineering admission path.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit Firmament V2 validation report JSON, including validation level and parser route.

options.name: --explain
options.description: Show V2 parser route, admission level and available instance counts.

options.name: --shadow
options.description: Developer report with separate original-source AST, bounded comparison and normal production validation.

options.name: --ast
options.description: Include the detailed AST with --shadow. Structural parsing does not establish semantic admission.

options.name: --parse-only
options.description: Use an available static analyzer; success is labelled parsed-not-built.

options.name: --locked
options.description: Require firmament.lock.toml; an existing lock is always checked.

options.name: --forge-pack
options.description: Load a trusted local .NET assembly containing IForgeConceptPack implementations. This executes local code; Aetheris does not sandbox external packs. Do not load untrusted packs.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Build/reimport and verify a model.

options.name: --expected-volume
options.description: Compare independent measured volume with external analytic evidence; never used by the evaluator.

options.name: --cad-assistant
options.description: Launch configured CAD Assistant for external display observation.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: External inspection timeout (default 30).

options.name: --evidence-dir
options.description: Override hash-tied evidence directory.

options.name: --require-external
options.description: Return exit 2 when CAD Assistant is unavailable.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the unified report on stdout.

options.name: --cadmata-path
options.description: Explicit Cadmata executable (legacy --cad-assistant-path is accepted). Otherwise packaged siblings, environment compatibility settings, PATH, and a development build are checked.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit launch details without waiting for Cadmata to exit.
